saw_head: At son-video.com, the biggest baskets are often not one person's decision.
saw_l1: A Klipsch 5.1 set, an OLED TV, a Yamaha amp with a pair of floorstanders: these are baskets of one to several thousand euros, and many are bought for a shared living room, a couple's flat, or as a gift several people chip in for.
saw_l2: Today the checkout knows one payer and one card. When that person has to collect the others' share first, or the card hits its limit on a 3,000 € basket, the order stays open. The 3x or 4x option helps one buyer, it does not help the second person who wants to pay their half.
saw_turn: That drop-off is the only thing we charge for. An order recovered through Split or Forward costs 3%. Everything else at your checkout costs nothing.
